name: The Egg
description: v1's quark soup: 10000 colored quarks (uud + udd) and electrons in a 2e5 disk under v1's force map 2, color force and 1/d Coulomb, plus 1/d gravity at v1's starting G ≈ 9e-38. Initial state of v1's script, which raises G by 1e41 at t = 106 and lowers it tenfold at t = 265, 424, 6360 and 6466, collapsing the soup into an egg. v1's random force noise and its rising quadratic drag are replaced by a constant linear drag.

forces.name: Nuclear (v1 force map 2)
forces.expression: -k * n_i * n_j * (a * exp(-x / b) - c * x)

forces.name: Color (v1)
forces.expression: k * n_i * n_j * (5 * (cr_i * cr_j + cg_i * cg_j + cb_i * cb_j) - 2 * (cr_i + cg_i + cb_i) * (cr_j + cg_j + cb_j)) / 3
